question: Who among the following founded the Saluva dynasty of Vijayanagara empire?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narasimha Deva Raya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Narasimha Deva Raya** founded the Saluva dynasty of the Vijayanagara Empire.
 
• The Saluva dynasty was established around the late 15th century.
 
• Narasimha Deva Raya was a key figure in stabilizing the empire during a period of internal strife and external threats.
 
• He was succeeded by his son, Immadi Narasimha, who continued the legacy of the Saluva dynasty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vijayanagara Empire**

 
 
• The Vijayanagara Empire was established in 1336 AD by Harihara I and Bukka Raya I of the Sangama dynasty.
 
• The empire is known for its patronage of art, architecture, and literature, as well as its military prowess.
 
• It played a crucial role in resisting the invasions of the Deccan Sultanates and preserving Hindu culture in South India.
 
 
 
• **Saluva Dynasty**
 
 
• The Saluva dynasty was the second ruling dynasty of the Vijayanagara Empire, succeeding the Sangama dynasty.
 
• It marked a period of transition and consolidation within the empire.
 
 
 
• **Krishnadeva Raya**
 
 
• Krishnadeva Raya, a ruler from the Tuluva dynasty, is often considered the greatest ruler of the Vijayanagara Empire.
 
• He reigned from 1509 to 1529 and expanded the empire to its zenith.
 
 
 
• **Decline of Vijayanagara Empire**
 
 
• The empire eventually declined after the Battle of Talikota in 1565, where it suffered a massive defeat against the combined forces of the Deccan Sultanates.
 
• This marked the end of the dominance of the Vijayanagara Empire in South India.
